title: Research: Gaussian nonlinear message copy floor 40b under explicit width pricing
head: 8c9964b7ab4419409d20762c8d78591701008d04
body:
**Research note / scoped negative result; no new κ or physical supplier.** Fixed-support, deterministic, zero-error nonlinear block messages on the 60 Gaussian E8 lines satisfy

`C >= max(ceil(2 sum_t b_t / 3), max_clique_Q sum_(t in Q) b_t)`.

For uniform b-bit demand, this gives **40b Gaussian / 80b rational pairing-rank units**. Direct messages give upper bound 60b; the nonlinear optimum remains unresolved. Demands confined to any nonorthogonal clique attain the concentration bound.

The essential premise is explicit: each q-bit message pays q times its Gaussian source/reader pairing rank, additively. This does not establish physical width pricing for arbitrary nonlinear circuits. With the additional inherited Dfc stage accounting, even the optimistic budget is `D/T <= 40b(s-3)`: three stages cannot give positive deficit while granting every other cost zero. Five or more stages and changed models remain open.

The proof composes **Sagar Thakrar's #738 Gaussian scalar geometric certificate**, **Alexander Templeton's #785 conditional-transcript argument**, and **Michael Fischler's #814 unequal-demand/concentration composition**. It adds the Gaussian nonlinear/block-message theorem and concrete controls of its assumptions. No method-priority claim. #770/#868 concern Gaussian clique-certificate ceilings and have distinct scope.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.10+ and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/gaussian-nonlinear-copy-floor/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/gaussian-nonlinear-copy-floor/test_package.py
```

Expected main marker:

```text
PASS_GAUSSIAN_NONLINEAR_COPY_FLOOR lines=60 cliques=640 flat_pairs=2579856 floor=40b no_new_kappa
```

Validation on CPython 3.12.14: the complete unchanged #738 calculation covers **2,579,856 nonempty flat pairs** and its six rejection controls. New checks cover 640 maximum cliques, every port's 128 incidences, all 8,704 maximal cliques for demand bounds, **49,152 correct nonlinear receiver decodes**, and **2,621,440 conditional projection assignments**. A separately written truth-table checker exhibits actual omitted-inversion/dropped-bit failures and correct-code counterexamples to weakened pricing or side-information premises. Three focused package tests pass, including receipt/source corruption, omission, invalid demands and output preservation. Both a minimal relocated copy and the exact staged Git-blob export pass the complete isolated replay with a byte-identical receipt. Selected-record integrity and whitespace checks pass. Optimized Python is deliberately rejected because the retained geometry uses assertions.

Only `research/gaussian-nonlinear-copy-floor/` is added. Base **f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631**; immutable predecessor heads:
- #738: `9671c5d72f3119ba26f3774f40aa7130c67bcf77`
- #785: `83e78085ae9c110a34bff87e71387292d85e47c0`
- #814: `d91c5152b314391406b0ec792b6765a5cf0af2f1`

Six #738 files and two predecessor proofs are retained verbatim with SHA256/Git-blob pins and original attribution. Further lineage and adjacent work are credited in NOTICE.md. OS-random seed **44**, structural decoder track; three candidates and the result/link are in the local claim because no sprint coordination issue exists. Final overlap refresh through #887 found no duplicate; all inspected predecessor heads stayed unchanged.

Fixed supports/widths, independent demands, orthogonal free side information and additive per-bit pricing are essential. All-size/compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape/exact recovery and analytic obligations remain inherited. Full repository/cold supplier suites, hosted CI and formal verification of the multiplication theorem are not claimed. Existing files, selected frontier and upstream/ remain unchanged; accepted conditional κ remains **1661634653669567/10^18**.

Prepared for **@ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate AI model/proof review and a separately implemented finite checker. No independent human peer review. Apache-2.0.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
